withdrawn_mass_J_minus_L1star.note: mean(J - L1*) is the average credit the withdraw-only correction removes per cell (rubric points); it is non-negative by construction, so L1* can never move toward a more generous rater.

R2.unit_of_resampling: question (CQ) cluster; one cell per question per variant

ppi_label_budget_scenario.target: mean over 23 paired questions of (R_B - R_A), AH rater score
ppi_label_budget_scenario.note: With every cell labelled (the realised audit) PPI collapses to the labelled mean, so it adds no information here; the scenario shows only whether J is informative enough about R to cut label cost. Finite-population sampling without replacement of questions; 20,000 draws, seed 20260913.

threshold_orientation.note: the bars are those of PREREG sec.2 (G4 falsification-only, G5); this block only places the human-human values beside them and does not change any gate status

R6.pointer: The A->B contrast across judge families is in parts/r4.json (Gemini and luna, three input conditions, 23 question pairs); sonnet scored the 48-cell panel only.

R7.plug_in_definition: 33 clusters drawn with replacement from the 33 observed; registered CI computed on the draw

G4.rule: falsified if QWK CI upper limit < 0.60; cannot pass

G2_analogue.rule: QWK CI lower limit >= 0.70 on a random 72-cell sample
G2_analogue.assumption: washout cells = a random 72 of the 188 primary cells; the two passes = AH R and the second rater's R (different raters; the registered G2 is same-rater and was NOT run)

G6_A_to_B_resolved.rule: L1* A->B 95% BCa CI excludes 0 (necessary part of G6; K>=6 and a second-judge direction are further requirements)

G3_judge_side_analogue.note: judge-side analogue (J<=1); the registered G3 uses the evaluator's A, not computable (8 of 24 ablated cells labelled). Cells treated as independent although the 24 cover 20 questions.

G7.rule: < 3% of 188 primary cells with dwell < 20 s
G7.note: process metric of the labelling sitting, not a property of the judge; binomial is a formality

G8.rule: falsification-only external spot check; not run

summary_rows.quantity: Over-credit (J>=2, S=0) vs under-credit (J<=1, S=1), AH, 188 cells
summary_rows.interpretation: Disagreement is two-sided and slightly under-credit-dominated; the judge is not net generous.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: WEAKENS the premise that only over-credit needs correcting (withdraw-only L1*, main L432/L466); pi-hat value and its 'lower bound' reading (L517) UNCHANGED

summary_rows.quantity: Same, second rater
summary_rows.interpretation: Sign of the net flips with the label source; neither net excludes 0.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: QUALIFIES the over-credit framing; SUPPORTS 'estimate is label-source sensitive'

summary_rows.quantity: Mean J vs mean R (AH); J-R
summary_rows.interpretation: On the 0-3 scale the judge is no more generous than either rater (stingier than the second rater).
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: QUALIFIES 'hidden over-credit' as the judge's dominant error; the unsupported-credit rates are UNCHANGED

summary_rows.quantity: Variant A (23 cells): J-R; over/under
summary_rows.interpretation: Judge under-credit sits in the text-chunk variant A, the baseline of the A->B contrast.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: WEAKENS the A->B reading as a graph effect (see R2)

summary_rows.quantity: Under-credit split J=0 / J=1 (AH)
summary_rows.interpretation: 17 of 20 under-credit cells are J=0 (judge cited no span); L1* can only remove, so it never repairs these.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: LEAVES UNCHANGED (descriptive)

summary_rows.quantity: A->B J / L1* / L_flip / L_R (AH), n=23
summary_rows.interpretation: Delta shrinks +0.565 -> +0.478 -> +0.174 -> -0.087 as correction becomes two-sided; sign reverses under the rater's own scores.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: SUPPORTS 'A->B unresolved'; WEAKENS positive A->B direction

summary_rows.quantity: A->B same, second rater
summary_rows.interpretation: Same ordering.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: SUPPORTS 'unresolved'; WEAKENS direction

summary_rows.quantity: Exact sign-flip permutation p, A->B (AH): J / L1* / L_flip / L_R
summary_rows.interpretation: No version reaches 0.05; judge-only J is 0.079 under the exact sign-flip test (bootstrap-free), against Wilcoxon 0.044 and a BCa lower limit one lattice step above 0.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: SUPPORTS 'unresolved'; qualifies the J descriptive 'clears zero' (exact p 0.079)

summary_rows.quantity: Rogan-Gladen corrected support-share contrast B-A (23 q)
summary_rows.interpretation: On the 23 shared questions the AH support share is 73.9% (A) and 73.9% (B), but J>=2 is 56.5% vs 87.0%: judge Se 0.71/Sp 0.83 on A vs Se 1.00/Sp 0.50 on B (counts Se 12/17 vs 17/17; Sp 5/6 vs 3/6, so small-n). The judge's operating point moves between A and B, so pooled Se/Sp cannot correct A->B.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: WEAKENS reading J's A->B as a graph effect; calls for per-variant calibration

summary_rows.quantity: PPI-style label saving for A->B
summary_rows.value: corr(dJ,dR) 0.23; SD ratio PPI/labelled-only 1.45 (PPI++ 0.97) at m=12
summary_rows.interpretation: J is nearly uninformative about question-level A->B differences, so partial labelling would not cut cost.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: LEAVES UNCHANGED

summary_rows.quantity: A->B full-bank (36 q, ineligible=0) vs eligible-only: J / L1* AH
summary_rows.interpretation: Full-bank CI excludes 0 only because A is set to 0 on its 13 ineligible questions (10 where B is eligible).
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: QUALIFIES Supplementary S25 ('order unchanged'): a full-bank A->B CI excludes 0 only under ineligible=0; registered eligible-only UNCHANGED

summary_rows.quantity: Same with ineligible=3 (matching upper bound)
summary_rows.interpretation: Bracket across the two fills spans -0.11..+0.72 (L1*): the full-bank contrast is not identified.
summary_rows.manuscript_claim: SUPPORTS 'unresolved' (conditional on fill rule)

summary_rows.quantity: A->B same questions: Gemini J / luna full / luna 60k / luna subgraph
summary_rows.interpretation: Direction is judge/condition dependent (2 up, 2 down); luna full is ceilinged (19 ties of 23) and its 90% CI lies in +-0.30.

summary_rows.quantity: P(A->B CI excludes 0) at n=23 vs true delta (L1*, sd 1.47)
